paper_title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative   Reward Model Based Simulated User
caption: Ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset. “critiquing” refers to attribute-based item critiquing, “scoring” refers to generative item scoring, and “ranking” refers to efficient candidate ranking.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the Recall@10 metric for four different approaches – “ours,” “critiquing,” “scoring,” and “ranking” – based on an ablation study conducted on the INSPIRED dataset. The horizontal axis represents the different approaches, ordered alphabetically from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “ranking”, represents the Recall@10 metric, with a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 0.4, and its tick labels are spaced at intervals of 0.02. The orange bar representing “ours” has a height of approximately 0.32, while the blue bar representing “ranking” has a height of approximately 0.18. The blue bar representing “critiquing” has a height of approximately 0.28, and the blue bar representing “scoring” has a height of approximately 0.16. All four bars are presented in a uniform color, with no bars visually emphasized.
